scope: Bounded final read-only review of the new SOURCE-CONVERSION-R3 compatibility claims. R1 and R2 remain the governing input and are not re-reviewed here. No source, test, Git, Vault, network, or external-process mutation.
freeze_status: The R3 supplement is effective only when the future conversion freeze binds the exact R1, R2, R3 and allowlist bytes, the R1 section mapping, and the delivered source-publication base.

checks.evidence: R3 requires every claim owned by the upgraded v2 paper to have nonempty evidence after provisional sections are applied. A preserved empty legacy claim refuses SOURCE_CONVERSION_UNSUPPORTED_CHANGE before staging; a valid newly mapped citation may satisfy the ordinary evidence-invalidation path. No evidence is invented, retired, deleted, or silently dropped.

The actual legacy active-extraction, raw, parser, run, and source inventory bytes remain historical inputs. The conversion does not promote the v1 active-extraction pointer into v2 history or association state; display_head and active-extraction mirrors remain null until an explicit display decision.

Unrelated paper and repository records, claim rows, and history remain unchanged. A regenerated unrelated rendered page is allowed only as an explicit compiler payload followed by full prospective validation and page-retirement refusal.

created_claim_ids, invalidated_claim_ids, and unchanged_claim_ids are sorted pairwise-disjoint sets whose union is exactly the IDs produced by provisional sections. location_migrated_claim_ids is independent, may overlap invalidated or unchanged and include preserved selected-paper claims absent from the light record, and never contains a created claim. Existing evidence spelling/order survives unchanged rows; missing reviewed_at gains only null.

New events use actor and decided_by exactly source-conversion-v1. Genesis and invalidation reasons are the exact R3 strings with validated record_id and association_id substitutions. No event is emitted when fingerprint and profile are unchanged, even if the light record ID changes. The v2 event validator requires nonempty reason/decided_by and content-derived event identity.

associate_source validates the complete association inventory, full observation/version key, exact raw bytes, and registration proof. Selection is independent of source_id and display_head; multiple declared versions may share raw bytes. Existing registration, version-conflict, and provenance-variant refusals remain active.

Supplied DOI and arXiv identifiers must normalize to the canonical paper ID or an existing canonical alias. Existing aliases remain immutable; the light sha256 paper identifier is not substituted for the formal canonical identity.

The freeze carries the unchanged R1 mapping explicitly: summary→one_sentence_conclusion (only core=true); method→method; architecture→representation_architecture; training_data→training_data; experiments→experiments_results; limitations→limitations; code_resources→code_resources; open_questions→research_question.

implementation_watchpoints: Apply the empty-evidence refusal before any staging write and preserve the exact refusal code.
Use the complete association inventory and exact raw/registration proof before selecting a reusable association.
Keep location migration independent from the three result sets and retain the exact legacy evidence wire form for unchanged claims.
Bind the explicit section_mapping above in the conversion freeze rather than relying only on the R1 prose reference.
